versions.short: The bill would modernize how the federal government publishes and distributes its documents through the Government Publishing Office. It would expand public information programs so that government materials are cataloged, preserved, and made freely available through a national collection and online catalog, and it would expand depository libraries' role in providing public access. It would also rename the Joint Committee on Printing as the Joint Committee on Publishing, update rules for printing congressional documents, the Federal Register, gifts, purchasing, and certain employee leave, and let the Library of Congress publish the Constitution Annotated mainly in digital form rather than in hardbound editions.
